history.jama_masjid_sig: The Friday Mosque of Ahmedabad, a stunning example of Indo-Islamic architecture built in 1423.
history.sidi_sayyid_sig: Famous for its intricate stone lattice work (jalis), a masterpiece of Gujarat's craftsmen.
history.adalaj_sig: A five-story stepwell combining Hindu, Islamic and Indian architectural styles, built in 1498.
history.ashram_sig: Mahatma Gandhi's headquarters during the Indian independence movement, located on the banks of the Sabarmati river.
history.kankaria_sig: Ahmedabad's largest recreational lake, built in 1451, offering boating and zoo facilities.
